verdict.rationale: Bugbot documents project-specific review guidelines via `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files and organization-wide rules created by team admins in Bugbot Automations. A verbose mode lists which rules were loaded for each review, and an 'Automatically Learn Rules' toggle is also documented. Missing for 10: AST/structural pattern rules, support for linked external style guides, independent or hands-on confirmation that custom rules are actually enforced.
